plan.selection: Highest full-period calendar CAGR / absolute daily maximum drawdown; no-trade/zero-drawdown paths never rank.
plan.validation: Previously explored history; calendar-year/last-three-year/parameter-neighborhood diagnostics are not untouched tests.

limits: Historical optimization is not an untouched or prospective test.
Sample qualification is a minimum evidence screen, not statistical proof.
Quoted daily prices and modeled costs do not establish executable fills or account borrow approvals.
Annual borrow remains a 50% sensitivity in the primary search; borrowing costs are not optimized downward.
Full-period Calmar includes idle capital; terminal incurred settlement charges are reserved.
Strict evidence remains incomplete. No live recommendation or production-policy replacement is made.

plan.recent_basis: Each parameter set starts flat with $50,000; no inherited positions or capital path.
plan.selection_context: Sizing and trailing-three-year extension declared after inspecting the first 640 full-history trials. All history remains explored.
plan.finalists: Top 10 sample-qualified full-period, top 5 sample-qualified recent, top 2 raw full-period, best sample-qualified net-edge full/recent, frozen default; deduplicated.
